# steven.kleynenberg.com — Complete Chronological Knowledge Base

> AI-distilled factual corpus of Steven Kleynenberg (born 1958-05-13, Delft, The Netherlands). Generated via deterministic source deduplication and Vertex AI Gemini extraction from curated archival texts, patents, peer-reviewed papers, and R&D records.

## 1. Identity, Attribution & Evidence Separation
- Full Name: Steven Kleynenberg (also published as S. E. Kleynenberg).
- Publishing Imprint: Kleynenberg Publishers (https://kleynenberg.com).
- Canonical Web Portal: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/ (https://kleynenberg.github.io/).
- Podcast Series: The Kleynenberg Perspective (https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAN7_k5CM5ZY).
- Direct Authorship & Inventorship: Co-inventor of international patent WO2014003543A1 (PCT/NL2012/050463) alongside Huub Rutten and Elsemiek ten Pas; co-author of peer-reviewed neural network papers (MetaNet / BSP400, 1990–1991) and acute stroke clinical workflow publication (MEDUSA, ESOCC 2015).
- Organizational & Consortium Roles: Former software/IP architect at Sopheon and contributor within European ITEA / Eureka R&D consortia (distinguished strictly from personal authorship).

## 4. Complete Facts on a Timeline

### 1. [1985 - 1993] Co-founder and Software Developer at Kleynenberg & Kleynenberg
- Category: Career / Organization
- Attribution / Role: Co-founder & Software Developer
- Summary (EN): Co-founded and operated a custom software consultancy alongside his father, engineering bespoke business applications and relational database systems for SMEs.
- Samenvatting (NL): Mede-oprichter en softwareontwikkelaar van een adviesbureau voor maatwerksoftware samen met zijn vader, gericht op bedrijfskritische toepassingen en relationele databasesystemen voor het MKB.
- Topics: Custom Software, SME Solutions, dBase, ANSI C, 80x86 assembly
- Verified URLs: https://kleynenberg.com

### 2. [1986 – 1991] Academic specialization — computer science, AI and complex systems
- Category: Career / Organization
- Attribution / Role: Student / Academic researcher
- Summary (EN): Specialized in computer science, artificial intelligence, theoretical psychology, and complex dynamical systems at Leiden University and Delft University of Technology.
- Samenvatting (NL): Studeerde informatica, kunstmatige intelligentie, theoretische psychologie en complexe dynamische systemen aan de Universiteit Leiden en de TU Delft.
- Topics: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Complex Systems, Connectionist neural architectures, Modular cognitive modeling, Parallel execution topologies
- Verified URLs: https://www.tudelft.nl, https://www.universiteitleiden.nl

### 3. [1988 – 1991] Architect — CALM development system and MetaNet network environment
- Category: Software / Architecture
- Attribution / Role: Architect and developer (in collaboration with Jacob M. J. Murre)
- Summary (EN): Designed and implemented MetaNet, a machine-independent, modular software environment for specifying, compiling, and simulating neural networks.
- Samenvatting (NL): Ontwierp en implementeerde MetaNet, een machine-onafhankelijke, modulaire softwareomgeving voor het specificeren, compileren en simuleren van neurale netwerken.
- Topics: Neural Networks, MetaNet, CALM, Software Architecture, T800 Transputers, Vector hardware
- Verified DOIs: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-0643-3_59
- Verified URLs: https://www.aalto.fi

### 4. [July 1990] The MetaNet Network Environment for the Development of Modular Neural Networks
- Category: Peer-Reviewed Paper
- Attribution / Role: Co-author
- Summary (EN): Introduces the MetaNet network environment, a graphical editor, compiler, and specification language for building modular neural networks, presented at INNC-90 in Paris.
- Samenvatting (NL): Introduceert de MetaNet-netwerkomgeving, een grafische editor, compiler en specificatietaal voor het bouwen van modulaire neurale netwerken, gepresenteerd op de INNC-90 in Parijs.
- Topics: Neural Networks, MetaNet, CALM, Modular Neural Networks, Graphical Editor
- Verified DOIs: https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-0643-3_59

### 5. [1991] Extending the MetaNet Network Environment: process control and machine independence
- Category: Peer-Reviewed Paper
- Attribution / Role: Co-author
- Summary (EN): Presents a general, parallel neurosimulator (GPN) designed to be extensible with novel network paradigms and parallel hardware, presented at ICANN-91 in Helsinki.
- Samenvatting (NL): Presenteert een algemene, parallelle neurosimulator (GPN) die is ontworpen om uitbreidbaar te zijn met nieuwe netwerkparadigma's en parallelle hardware, gepresenteerd op ICANN-91 in Helsinki.

### 9. [November 1991] Integrating the BSP400 neurocomputer with the MetaNet Network Environment
- Category: Peer-Reviewed Paper
- Attribution / Role: Co-author
- Summary (EN): Describes the integration of the Brain Style Processor (BSP400), a massively parallel 400-processor neurocomputer, with the MetaNet Network Environment using modular interrupt-driven device drivers.
- Samenvatting (NL): Beschrijft de integratie van de Brain Style Processor (BSP400), een massaal parallelle 400-processor neurocomputer, met de MetaNet-netwerkomgeving via modulaire interrupt-gestuurde apparaatstuurprogramma's.
- Topics: BSP400, Neurocomputer, Parallel Processing, Device Drivers, MetaNet
- Verified DOIs: https://doi.org/10.1109/IJCNN.1991.170608
- Verified URLs: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/170608/, https://openalex.org/W1835238853, https://steven.kleynenberg.com/papers/murre-et-al-1991-bsp400-metanet-ijcnn.pdf, https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Steven-Kleynenberg
